paragraphs: Rabbi Yishmael, son of Rabbi Tanchum.

He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah, beginning of ch. 22, together with Rabbi Hanin the son of Rabbi; they said in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah. Hyman calls this a scribal error and proposes the reading as cited in Shir HaShirim Rabbah, beginning of ch. 7: Rabbi Shmuel bar Tanhum and Rabbi Hanan the son of Rabbi Berekhyah in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah.
And in Yalkut Kohelet, ch. 5, on the verse 'veyitron': Rabbi Yishmael bar Tanhuma and Rabbi Natan the son of Rabbi Berekhyah in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah.

notes.text: Yishmael/Shmuel, Hanin/Hanan/Natan and Tanchum/Tanchuma are meaningful reported variants. Hyman’s proposed correction is retained as his.
